messages: My package was due on Tuesday, but nothing has turned up yet. Could you check where it is?
The tracking page hasn’t changed in five days, and I still don’t have my delivery.
I was expecting this last week, but there’s been no sign of it. Can you help me figure out what’s going on?
The carrier’s update says it’s on the way, but it hasn’t moved since Friday. Is there any way to get a clearer update?
Nothing was left at my door, even though the estimated delivery date has passed.
Hi, I’m still waiting on the box I purchased. The tracking hasn’t been useful, and I’m wondering if it’s gone missing.
This was supposed to arrive a few days ago. I’ve checked around the building and asked my neighbors, but no one has seen it.
Could someone look into my shipment? It seems to have stopped moving, and I haven’t received anything.
The delivery window ended yesterday, but the package never showed up. Please let me know what I should do next.
I’m getting concerned because the tracking has been stuck at the same facility for over a week, and there’s still nothing here.
My parcel hasn’t come, and the delivery estimate keeps changing. Can you tell me when I might actually receive it?
I paid for this a while ago and still don’t have it. The carrier hasn’t posted a new update in several days.
